description: List the free icon libraries available through the hosted Supericons MCP server. Use this before filtering by library or when a user asks which icon libraries are supported.
name: list_libraries

libraries.description: Free icon libraries available through this hosted MCP server.

count.description: Number of icons in the library.

description.description: Brief public description of the icon library.

id.description: Library key used in tool calls.

label.description: Human-readable library label with key, for example Supericons (si).

outlineCount.description: Number of outline icons served by the hosted MCP server.

solidCount.description: Number of solid icons served by the hosted MCP server.

supportedStyles.description: Styles verified on the hosted serving path.

publicRecordCount.description: Number of public semantic icon records searchable through the hosted MCP server.

title: List Libraries
